name: Atomic Xiangqi: twelve engine games
description: The variant lab’s engine games under the rules Mistboard plays: ten wins by the stronger engine (ten million nodes against one million, six by explosion and four by checkmate) and the two best-play draws that show what the game looks like when nobody errs. Notes mark every explosion and the move that decided each game. Rules: mistboard.com/rules/atomic-xiangqi

games.name: Win 1: explosion after a seventy-move hunt (Red)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Red (10 million nodes) against Black (1 million). The longest win on file. Level for six moves, then Black’s cannon swap at 6…Cf6 hands Red a pawn, and by move 30 Red is winning. What follows is the hunt: twenty-two moves in this game are check in the wide sense, the black general walks e10, f9, f10, e9, and the chariot finally reaches e9 beside it on move 73.

6.text: Cf6: the cannon pairing Red wanted. Red +1.8 already.

19.text: Rxb2: the chariot takes the chariot. The blast finds nothing else, a clean trade.

58.text: Cxf10: Black’s cannon takes Red’s. A shot takes one piece and nothing beside it, and this one opens the f-file for Red. +14.5.

64.text: Hxf7: the horse takes a horse, and the blast removes the other horse on f6 and the advisor on f8. Three pieces off for one capture.

145.text: Rxe9+: the chariot takes the advisor beside the general on e8, and the blast ends the game.

games.name: Win 2: checkmate after the palace is emptied (Black)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Black (10 million nodes) against Red (1 million). Red holds until 49.Cd5; then 56…Rxc5 takes a chariot and a cannon with one capture, 73.Rxf2 costs Red its own advisor to the blast, and from move 83 Red is lost. The finish is the unusual part: Black blows up both of its own advisors (88…Exe8) to clear the file, and 92…Pdxd3 empties Red’s palace before the horse mates.

49.text: Cd5: Red’s cannon steps into the open file. Black is better from here (-2.2).

56.text: Rxc5: one capture, two pieces. The chariot on c5 goes, and the cannon on d5 beside it goes in the blast.

73.text: Rxf2: Red takes the chariot, and the blast takes Red’s own advisor on e2 with it. A capture next to your own piece is a capture of it.

85.text: Pg8: the last mistake. Every line mates from here.

88.text: Ecxe8: Black’s elephant takes the horse on e8 and the blast removes both of Black’s own advisors. The general on e10 is not adjacent, so it survives, and the e-file is open.

92.text: Pdxd3: the soldier takes the advisor, and the elephant on e3 goes in the blast. Red’s palace is empty.

games.name: Win 3: a horse blasts its own advisor, and the file opens (Red)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Red (10 million nodes) against Black (1 million). Level until 36…Cd2 leaves the back ranks; then 42…Hxf9 takes a cannon and blows up Black’s own advisor on f10 with it, and the palace never recovers. Red wins by explosion on move 38, the chariot taking the cannon on d8 beside the general.

12.text: Rf8: already a pawn and a half for Red.

42.text: Hxf9: the horse takes the cannon, and the blast removes Black’s own advisor on f10. The palace is one advisor lighter for nothing.

60.text: Cb9: +19.9. The general has no cover left.

75.text: Rxd8+: the chariot takes the cannon beside the general on d9; the blast takes the general and the elephant on e8 with it.

games.name: Win 4: three pieces in one blast (Black)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Black (10 million nodes) against Red (1 million). Red’s 13.Cxh10 wins a chariot for a cannon and Red is lost eight moves later anyway: 21.Pc5 walks into a corner collapse, and 36…Hxb1 takes the horse with the chariot on a1 and the elephant on c1 beside it. The general is chased to d2 and blown up from e2.

13.text: Cxh10: cannon for chariot. The shot takes only the chariot, and on paper Red is a little better.

21.text: Pc5: -11.5. The corner is collapsing and the soldier move does nothing about it.

36.text: Hxb1: the horse takes the horse, and the blast removes the chariot on a1 and the elephant on c1. Three pieces for one capture.

68.text: Rxe2+: the chariot takes the advisor, and the general on d2 is beside it.

games.name: Win 5: the soldier takes the horse, the blast takes the advisor (Red)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Red (10 million nodes) against Black (1 million). 17.Cxf8 wins a chariot for a cannon; 43.Pxf9 takes a horse with a soldier and the blast removes the advisor on e9 beside it, which is the move that opens the palace. Black’s checks on moves 28 and 29 change nothing, and the horse finishes: 75.Hxc10 takes the elephant next to the general on d10.

17.text: Cxf8: cannon for chariot, the shot taking only its target.

43.text: Pxf9: a soldier takes the horse, and the blast removes the advisor on e9. The general on e10 is now beside an empty point, and every piece that reaches it is a threat.

58.text: Cff2+: check, and it costs Black a cannon. +25.9.

75.text: Hxc10: the horse takes the elephant beside the general on d10; the chariot on b10 goes in the same blast.

games.name: Win 6: a red horse walks into the middle (Black)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Black (10 million nodes) against Red (1 million). 31.Hg3 is the losing move (-10.7), 39.He4 and 41.Hxd6 make it worse, and Black lets one mate slip (44…Rh7) before finding the finish: 62…Rxe2+ takes the advisor beside the general on e1.

31.text: Hg3: the horse leaves the flank and Black’s attack has a target. -10.7.

41.text: Hxd6: the horse takes a horse; nothing else is in the blast, and the position is lost (-24.1).

44.text: Rh7: Black misses a forced mate here. Still winning by twelve pawns.

57.text: Rxg3: Red’s chariot takes the chariot, and the blast removes Red’s own cannon on h3.

62.text: Rxe2+: the chariot takes the advisor; the general on e1 goes in the blast.

games.name: Win 7: two self-blasts, one each (Black)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Black (10 million nodes) against Red (1 million). Both sides blow up their own pieces: 20…Hxf9 costs Black an advisor, 37.Hxb1 costs Red an elephant, and the second matters more (-11.8). 46…Hxe2 takes the advisor and clears the elephant and the horse beside it, and the mate comes on the first rank.

20.text: Hxf9: the horse takes the cannon, and Black’s own advisor on f10 goes with it.

37.text: Hxb1: Red takes the cannon, and the blast removes Red’s own elephant on c1. -11.8.

46.text: Hxe2: three pieces in one blast, the advisor on e2, the elephant on e3 and the horse on f2.

games.name: Win 8: the shortest win, twenty-three moves (Black)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Black (10 million nodes) against Red (1 million). 11.Kd1 steps the general into the corner of the palace early (-2.0), 16…Hxh1 takes a horse and a cannon with one capture, and 35.Ce4 is the losing move. 46…Rxf1+ takes the advisor beside the general on e1.

11.text: Kd1: the general leaves e1. -2.0, and it never gets back.

16.text: Hxh1: the horse takes the horse, and the cannon on h2 goes in the blast.

35.text: Ce4: every line loses from here.

46.text: Rxf1+: the chariot takes the advisor beside the general on e1.

games.name: Win 9: a soldier takes three pieces (Red)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Red (10 million nodes) against Black (1 million). 24…Pg6 is the mistake (+5.2), and 29.Pxc9 is the game: a soldier takes the chariot on c9 and the blast removes the elephant on c10 and the horse on c8 as well. Red converts by explosion on move 35.

29.text: Pxc9: a soldier takes a chariot, and the elephant and the horse beside it go too. Soldiers survive blasts; nothing survives a soldier’s capture.

69.text: Rxe9+: the chariot takes the advisor, and the blast reaches the general on e10.

games.name: Win 10: mated by a soldier (Black)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Black (10 million nodes) against Red (1 million). One explosion decides it: 48…Rxd3 takes the advisor on d3 and removes the elephant on e3 and the cannon on d2 with it, and Red’s palace is bare. The mate is a soldier’s: 60…Pe1+.

48.text: Rxd3: the chariot takes the advisor, and the elephant on e3 and the cannon on d2 go in the blast.

60.text: Pe1+: checkmate by a soldier, the one piece a blast cannot remove.

games.name: The cork: a cannon in front of a chariot (2 million a side, draw)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Both sides at two million nodes. After the exchanges the ending is the new chariot-against-cannon idea. Black’s general is on f10 and Red’s chariot wants the f-file; Black’s cannon stands directly in front of the chariot and slides sideways with it. It blocks the chariot and, because a cannon’s shot takes only its target, it threatens nothing back. The corking side, Black, is the forced one (every alternative is worse by two pawns or mates); Red has an equal move (Rf2) it did not take. Draw by repetition after 34 plies.

15.text: Pxc5: soldier takes soldier. A soldier is removed only by capture.

22.text: Hxd6: the horse takes the cannon; only the cannon goes.

32.text: Cf4: the cork. Black’s cannon stands in front of Red’s chariot on the f-file and slides with it; the shot it could take is one piece, and the chariot is not it.

games.name: Best play at twenty million nodes (draw)
games.event: Atomic Xiangqi, engine games under the cannon-shot rules
games.intro: Twenty million nodes a move for both sides, the deepest game on file. 3.Pc5 is the only swing (-0.3), then a game of trades: 14…Rxb9, 17.Rxb10 taking the elephant beside the chariot, the cannon shots 29.Cxh4 and 31.Cxf7, five soldier captures, and a level ending that repeats after 88 plies. This is what the engine thinks the game is with nobody making a mistake.

17.text: Rxb10: the chariot takes the chariot, and the elephant on c10 goes in the blast.

31.text: Cxf7: a cannon shot. One piece.

88.text: Draw by repetition. 0.00 for the last forty plies.
